channel.title: Fly Kai Tak blog
channel.description: News and features from Fly Kai Tak, a browser flight simulator of the 1998 Runway 13 approach into Hong Kong Kai Tak.

item.title: Share Fly Kai Tak posts on Threads
item.description: Fly Kai Tak blog posts can now be shared on Threads with one click, with the title and link pre-filled.

item.title: Landmarks tour, plus Ocean Park and Happy Valley
item.description: A tour of the Hong Kong landmarks in Fly Kai Tak, with screenshots, plus the new Ocean Park amusement park and Happy Valley Racecourse.

item.title: Flying Kai Tak on your phone: landscape, a cleaner toolbar and bigger controls
item.description: Fly Kai Tak on mobile: a compact toolbar with a More drawer, landscape touch controls, a rotate prompt for portrait, full screen on Begin descent and safe-area support.

item.title: The checkerboard turn: flying the IGS 13 approach
item.description: How the famous Runway 13 IGS approach into Kai Tak works in Fly Kai Tak: the 088° course, the checkerboard on the hill, the 47° right turn over Kowloon City and the landing grade.

item.title: Real Hong Kong: building 1998 from open data
item.description: How Fly Kai Tak builds Hong Kong from Lands Department open data and SRTM terrain, and the 1998 corrections: no Kai Tak redevelopment, no West Kowloon buildings, and the Walled City as an option.

item.title: Typhoons, fog and city lights: weather and night at Kai Tak
item.description: Weather and night flying in Fly Kai Tak: clear, rain, typhoon, storm, low cloud and fog presets, wind gusts and turbulence, lightning, and a lit-up Kowloon at night.
